text.id: Dinda memanggil…
text.en: Dinda is calling…

text.id: Tersambung
text.en: Connected

text.id: Ka? Sori. Gue tahu kalian udah nggak ngomong. Gue nggak tahu harus nelpon siapa lagi.
text.en: Ka? Sorry. I know you two don't talk anymore. I didn't know who else to call.

text.id: Senin malem dia pamit mau rekaman. Abis itu HP-nya mati. Motornya masih di rumah. Dompetnya juga.
text.en: Monday night she said she was going out to record. After that her phone went dead. Her scooter's still at home. Her wallet too.

text.id: Apa yang lo bilang?
text.en: What do you say?

text.id: Polisi udah dikabarin?
text.en: Have you told the police?

text.id: Mungkin dia cuma butuh waktu sendiri.
text.en: Maybe she just needs some time alone.

text.id: Lo sekarang di mana? Lo aman?
text.en: Where are you now? Are you safe?

text.id: Udah. Mereka bilang tunggu. Katanya cewek umur dua puluh dua kabur dari rumah itu biasa.
text.en: Yeah. They said to wait. They said a twenty-two-year-old girl running away from home is normal.

text.id: Itu yang polisi bilang. Gue kira lo beda.
text.en: That's what the police said. I thought you'd be different.

text.id: Gue di rumah. Sama Ibu. Ibu nggak tidur dari Senin.{w} Makasih udah nanya.
text.en: I'm at home. With Mom. Mom hasn't slept since Monday.{w} Thanks for asking.

text.id: Ka, dengerin. Tadi siang HP cadangannya Kak Sekar nyala sebentar di kamarnya. Ada satu pesan keluar yang nggak terkirim.
text.en: Ka, listen. This afternoon Sekar's spare phone turned on for a moment in her room. There was one outgoing message that never went through.

text.id: Buat lo.
text.en: To you.

text.id: Isinya apa?
text.en: What does it say?

text.id: "Ka. Inget jam lima pagi itu? Gue masih di sana."
text.en: "Ka. Remember five in the morning? I'm still there."

text.id: Gue nggak ngerti maksudnya. Lo ngerti?
text.en: I don't get it. Do you?

text.id: Jam lima pagi. Dermaga Muara Angke.
text.en: Five in the morning. The Muara Angke pier.

text.id: Gue ngerti. Gue ke Jakarta sekarang.
text.en: I get it. I'm coming to Jakarta now.

text.id: Nggak tahu. Tapi gue ke sana besok.
text.en: No idea. But I'll come tomorrow.

text.id: Sekarang? Ini jam dua pagi, Ka.{w} ...Oke. Gue tunggu di rumah.
text.en: Now? It's two in the morning, Ka.{w} ...Okay. I'll be waiting at home.

text.id: Oke. Gue tunggu di rumah. Jangan nggak dateng.
text.en: Okay. I'll be at home, waiting. Don't not show up.

text.id: Ka? Halo? ...Dia selalu bilang lo kabur kalau ada yang berat. Jangan kali ini.
text.en: Ka? Hello? ...She always said you run when things get heavy. Not this time.

text.id: Panggilan berakhir
text.en: Call ended
